objective: strict-greedy batch-1 generation with persistent device state, no historical-prefix recompute, and one host-visible synchronization per speculative round

logical_roles.purpose: run the original ChunkGatedDeltaRule prefill path once over the prompt and produce the first clean anchor
required_outputs: projectable target features for real prompt rows

logical_roles.purpose: ordinary greedy and the exact zero-accept fallback without Draft execution
reuse committed Draft KV and only newly committed Target features to produce proposal IDs
required_outputs: proposal IDs in a device-resident buffer

logical_roles.rows: anchor plus proposals, exact T in 2..16
logical_roles.purpose: verify once, compute the longest matching proposal prefix, select the committed Target state slot, and emit a compact transaction result
required_outputs: projectable features for anchor plus accepted proposals

state_ownership.owner: one C++ request context with persistent device buffers
state_ownership.target_full_attention: provisional physical KV writes are allowed; only the logical cursor advances by anchor plus accepted proposals and rejected slots are overwritten later
state_ownership.target_gdr_and_conv: verify may materialize per-row banks as graph workspace, but its graph tail gathers slot a and persists only the selected scalar state
state_ownership.draft: committed KV persists; the transient mask block is never committed

strict_greedy_transaction.accepted: largest a in [0,K] such that p[j] == t[j] for every j < a
strict_greedy_transaction.selected_target_state_slot: a because slot a is the state after anchor plus a accepted proposals
strict_greedy_transaction.all_match_commit: p[0:K] followed by t[K], unless an accepted proposal is EOS
strict_greedy_transaction.next_anchor: the correction t[a] or all-match bonus t[K]; it is emitted but not processed by Target until the next call
strict_greedy_transaction.eos: never emit a token after the first EOS

bytes_at_batch1_kv_max_len_2048_verify_t.notes: excludes model weights, model workspaces, I/O buffers, allocator/runtime overhead and optional feature/logit intermediates

physical_oms: target-verify-commit with a proven T=1 decode gear
physical_topology_candidates.condition: custom operators, TorchAir and ATC preserve exact T=1 and T=2..16 gears in one Target step artifact
physical_topology_candidates.risk: Target weights may still exist in both prefill and verify artifacts

physical_topology_candidates.condition: static graphs outperform multi-gear and the summed queried/loaded weight memory fits the declared device budget
physical_topology_candidates.risk: three different Target artifacts can duplicate the 4B Target weights; four files alone do not imply speedup

physical_topology_candidates.condition: the different original-GDR and GDR-MTP branches compile, preserve custom nodes, pass parity, and beat static alternatives
physical_topology_candidates.risk: dynamic control/shape support and workspace inflation are unproven for the receiver custom operators

physical_oms: device-side Draft to Target verify/accept supergraph
physical_topology_candidates.condition: profile proves launch/host boundaries dominate and duplicated weights/workspace remain acceptable
physical_topology_candidates.risk: large graph compile risk and possible Target/Draft weight duplication

topology_selection_gates.serial_workspace_budget: maximum queried workSize when all resident models are proven to execute serially with one shared workspace
topology_selection_gates.weight_budget: sum queried weightSize; cross-artifact weight sharing must not be assumed
topology_selection_gates.state_budget: persistent state plus peak transient state/workspace plus I/O and a declared safety margin
topology_selection_gates.load_test: load the complete candidate set together on the exact 310P product before timing
topology_selection_gates.profile: unprofiled 3 warmups plus 10 measurements for promotion; msprof 1..3 iterations only for diagnosis
topology_selection_gates.winner: lowest median end-to-end model-loop latency among zero-mismatch candidates, not the candidate with the most or fewest OM files

hot_loop.stream: one request stream unless profile proves overlap safe and beneficial
hot_loop.draft_to_verify: proposal IDs stay on device and bind directly to Target verify
hot_loop.synchronization: one host-visible synchronization after verify/commit per speculative round
hot_loop.prefill: never execute Draft proposal or full LM head for non-final prompt chunks
hot_loop.verify: never recompute the committed historical prefix

activation_gate.approval_scope: replace the active full-prefix integrated OM ABI with explicit device-state graph boundaries and a device-side exact accept/commit tail
required_before_default: AIR custom-node preservation for every role
ATC success for every selected gear
ordinary and DFlash zero token/EOS mismatch

claim_boundary: This file freezes a proposed exact ABI and measurement decision rule. It is not evidence that any topology exports, loads, fits, is correct, or is faster on a physical Ascend310P device.
